verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init --dry-run` previews the skill changes before anything is written. A hands-on probe confirmed it lists each file it would create (SKILL.md under both .agents/skills and .claude/skills) without writing anything. The real run writes those skill files into the project, where they can be read and committed for team review. Missing for 10: the dry run shows file paths only, not the instruction text itself; there is no explicit documentation of the skill file contents or confirmation that no scripts are added; reading files after install is implied by the local, committable files rather than shown directly.
